sentence_stem: Had the committee known about the delay,
correct_completion: they would have postponed the vote.
full_sentence: Had the committee known about the delay, they would have postponed the vote.
acceptable_variants: they would have delayed the vote.
they would have put the vote off.

options.text: the vote will be held as planned.
options.why_wrong: This is a plain future statement. It ignores the hypothetical past meaning set by the inverted 'Had the committee known' clause.

options.text: they would have postponed the vote.
they postponed the vote last year.
options.why_wrong: This describes a separate past event. It does not complete the third conditional result that the inverted 'Had' clause requires.

options.text: postponing the vote would be a poor idea.
options.why_wrong: This gives an opinion but does not state the result that the committee would have produced in that hypothetical situation.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'Had' + subject + past participle
explanation: In an inverted third conditional, 'Had' replaces 'If' and the subject comes before the past participle. The main clause must use 'would have' plus a past participle to express what would have happened in an unreal past situation.
